content: For our experimentation, we use the sub corpora of the BioScope Corpus (BIBREF1), namely the BioScope Abstracts sub corpora, which is referred to as BA, and the BioScope Full Papers sub corpora, which is referred to as BF. We also use the SFU Review Corpus (BIBREF2), which is referred to as SFU.
